Note::tex¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

NoteTexAccessor Note::tex() const noexcept

Enter The TeX/LaTeX Operation Surface¶

tex() binds a lightweight accessor to the current Note. The accessor groups TeX/LaTeX-source cleanup, math-delimiter handling, construct removal, environment extraction, macro expansion, math simplification and standardization, format conversion, structural and semantic extraction, and command/symbol replacement without crowding the general Note surface with tex_-prefixed method names.

The call does not parse TeX, allocate storage, copy the Note, or change its dtype. It returns a temporary proxy containing one pointer to the receiver; the selected operation performs the work. This keeps Note itself a one-pointer intrusive handle while allowing fluent pipelines:

const auto cleaned = source.tex().strip_comments().tex().strip_labels();
const auto plain = cleaned.tex().to_text();

The accessor is valid for the full expression in which it is created. Store the Note, not the accessor, when work must outlive that expression. Each accessor method documents its own accepted dtype, shape behavior, options, and result type.

Open the Note TeX Accessor API Reference

Example: Strip Then Convert¶

const auto source = pluss::make_note(
    "\\documentclass{article}\n"
    "% draft note\n"
    "\\begin{document}\n"
    "Body \\textbf{bold} text.\n"
    "\\end{document}\n");
const auto stripped = source.tex().strip_comments().tex().strip_preamble();
const auto plain = stripped.tex().to_text();

std::cout << pluss::note::print(plain) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
"Body bold text."

The comment and the class/\begin{document}/\end{document} scaffolding are gone after the first two calls; to_text() then unwraps \textbf{bold} into plain bold.
